SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code, st.phasefactor AS historical_phase, AVG(s.scancount) AS avg_scancount, AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_compression_ratio
FROM scans AS s
INNER JOIN sites AS st ON s.zoneref = st.zoneregistry
WHERE s.scancount >= 11
GROUP BY s.zoneref, st.phasefactor
ORDER BY avg_compression_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
